cards.statement: Since layouts and pages render in parallel, two fetches awaited back to back in one component run in parallel too.
cards.explanation: Parallel rendering applies across route segments. Inside one component each await blocks the next request; start both requests first and await them together to overlap them.
cards.misconception: Parallel rendering of route segments also parallelizes sequential awaits inside a component.

cards.statement: In Next.js 16 with cacheComponents: false, the smallest revalidate among a route's layouts and page sets its frequency.
cards.explanation: In the previous model, a route inherits the shortest revalidate interval specified by its layouts or page.
cards.volatilityNote: Scoped to the previous caching model.
